name: dryrun_02_phoenix_smoke_test
notes: Pre-registration Q1 v0.9.8, Section 6 'Dry run and smoke test (about 10 minutes, drawn from the reserve; first; sets locked time per point and the job overhead)' and 'the ibm_phoenix smoke test uses about 5 Flex minutes'; Gate 2 (Section 5) is checked on its output; tracker P1.2.2. Window 9-11 October 2026. Paper 1 smoke test: the 4x5 patch (n = 20, origin (8,1), qubits 81-85, 91-95, 101-105, 111-115, edge 93_103 under the 2026-09-19T192510Z snapshot; re-placed by place_patch and re-checked against the live properties on the day, Deviation 26) at L = 2 and L = 8, k = 1, M = 10 draws, 4096 shots, resilience 0 / 1 / 2 (three Estimator jobs: locked time per point, depth ceiling, mitigation overhead). Probes (Section 3b, Deviation 16 reset dial, kill rules (a)-(d)): the reset-arm shifted pair at n = 20, L = 8, k = L, p = 0.25 in the Deviation 27 design scaled down for a probe (16 masks x 16 shots per (draw, shift) instead of 256 x 16; theta from seed 20260919, mask m from seed + 1 + m) and its delay(400 ns)-matched control with the same masks and theta, each at resilience 0 AND resilience 1: the resilience-1 pair is the kill rule (d) test (the Estimator accepting a mid-circuit reset at the level used on the Paper 1 grid; untested on Marrakesh, post-run review D6), the resilience-0 pair is its reference and the transpilation check (kill rule (c): mid_circuit_measures must be 0, reset must survive as the native 400 ns instruction). The reset-error characterisation mini-sequence on the 20 patch qubits (prepare |1> -> native reset -> measure Z, 1024 shots, resilience 0; P(1) = (1 - <Z>)/2; kill rule (a) threshold 2e-2 on any dial-patch qubit; Gate 2 (e)); its readout reference P(1 | prepare |0>) is the ladder's 1 us prepare-|0> rung on the same qubits. The rep_delay ladder of Section 6 / Deviation 23 (b) on the n = 20 patch: prepare-|0> and prepare-|1> then measure Z on the 20 patch qubits, 4096 shots each, at execution.rep_delay = 1 us (the ibm_phoenix default on the 2026-09-19 configuration ledger, set explicitly so the granted value is read back), 5 us, 20 us and 250 us (the Heron default); one Estimator job per rung, options.execution.rep_delay set per job and logged as rep_delay_granted_s with backend default_rep_delay, rep_delay_range and dynamic_reprate_enabled; acceptance (Gate 2 (c)) is a state-preparation bias change below twice the 4096-shot floor between the default and the booked floor (both 1 us here; the 250 us rung is the slow reference). A rung the backend refuses (dynamic_reprate_enabled false) fails only its own job and is logged with the error. The runner records the ISA instruction names, measure count and reset/delay durations per circuit, and re-checks the placed patch against the live properties before submitting (layout_check: enforce; Deviation 26 cuts: readout < 3e-2, operational, init error < 5e-4 per qubit; CZ error < 5e-3 per patch coupler; no override on edge 93_103 or its L = 2 cone). Budget model v2 (Deviation 24): 10 jobs; the ladder jobs are timed at their own rep_delay in both columns. Target at most 5 Flex minutes at the default (1 us). At the 250 us Heron default the list would exceed 5 minutes by a few seconds; the pre-registered remedy is to drop the L = 8 resilience-2 point's M from 10 to 5 (about -33 s at 250 us), not to touch shots. Nothing is submitted while dry_run is true and the pre-flight review permalink is TBD.
